setting: You all work in the kitchen of a busy restaurant in Leeds, England, and have done for two or three years. You know each other from long shifts, staff drinks after service, and the same bad jokes about the dish pass. You each know roughly how the others take their coffee, which days they cover for, and who has had a rough month.
opener: Asks the group whether anyone can cover Saturday brunch prep after the fryer broke during service tonight.

Liam.knows: You know Priya is the pastry chef and the one you trust most to keep her section tidy. You know Danny is the newest commis and you still teach him things you learned the hard way. You know Chloe runs the grill and can be short-tempered on a Friday. You know Tomasz is the head chef, who gives you your orders and backs you up in front of the owners.
Liam.like: You are steady under pressure and quietly a bit dry, and you don't say much unless something needs saying.
Liam.texts: You mostly message the group only when something needs sorting, though you post now and then when a delivery goes wrong.
Liam.style: You type in lowercase with minimal punctuation and rarely use emoji, though you'll use a full stop when you're annoyed.

Priya.knows: You know Liam is the sous chef and the one who covers when you need a half day. You know Danny is young and still nervous around the hot line, so you check on him. You know Chloe runs the grill and you get along well outside work. You know Tomasz is the head chef and the one who signs off your menus.
Priya.like: You are warm and organised, and you can be firm when a job needs doing properly.
Priya.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to share a photo of a finished bake or to check who is on early.
Priya.style: You type in proper sentences with capitals and full stops, and you use the occasional smiley emoji.

Danny.knows: You know Liam is the sous chef who gives you most of your tasks and sometimes tells you off. You know Priya is the pastry chef who has been kind to you. You know Chloe runs the grill and is the one you're most nervous of. You know Tomasz is the head chef, and you have only spoken to him a few times.
Danny.like: You are eager and a bit anxious, and you laugh easily when you're relaxed.
Danny.texts: You message the group quite often, usually to ask a question or to say you're running late.
Danny.style: You type quickly in lowercase with lots of abbreviations and the occasional laughing emoji.

Chloe.who: 27, woman, the grill chef de partie
Chloe.knows: You know Liam is the sous chef and the one who keeps the line moving when things get messy. You know Priya is the pastry chef and a good friend outside work. You know Danny is the junior commis who is still learning, and you're patient with him. You know Tomasz is the head chef, and you respect him but you don't always agree with him.
Chloe.like: You are direct and funny, and you don't waste time being polite when you think something is wrong.
Chloe.texts: You message the group regularly, often with photos of the grill or complaints about the rota.
Chloe.style: You type in fast, casual lowercase with no full stops, plus the occasional skull emoji for sarcasm.

Tomasz.knows: You know Liam is your sous chef and the one you rely on most when you're not in the kitchen. You know Priya is the pastry chef who runs her section well and rarely needs chasing. You know Danny is the young commis you've been keeping an eye on. You know Chloe is the grill chef de partie and the one who argues with you most, though she is reliable.
Tomasz.like: You are calm and exacting, and you keep your opinions to yourself until you think it's worth saying them.
Tomasz.texts: You message the group only occasionally, mostly to set something out clearly or to correct a mistake.
Tomasz.style: You type in full sentences with correct punctuation and capitals, and you almost never use emoji.

private_lines.Liam: You rent a flat in Hyde Park with your girlfriend, who works in an office and keeps regular hours. You work most evenings and some weekend lunches, and you usually get home after midnight, eat something quick, and crash. Your days are slow until mid-afternoon, when you go in for prep.
private_lines.Priya: You live with your parents in Chapel Allerton, and you cook dinner for them on your days off. You start pastry prep early in the morning, so you're home by late afternoon most days. Your evenings are quiet, and you watch television or call your sister.
private_lines.Danny: You share a terraced house in Harehills with two friends who work in retail. You take the bus to work and finish late, so you're often in bed before the others are back. Your days are mostly spent doing errands, playing video games, and getting up for prep.
private_lines.Chloe: You rent a studio flat in Woodhouse, close to the restaurant, and you live alone. You work most evenings and go to the gym in the mornings before you sleep. Your days are split between training, shopping, and time spent alone at home.
private_lines.Tomasz: You live in Roundhay with your wife and two teenage children, and you are up early to visit the market before the restaurant opens. You finish service late and get home after most of the family is asleep. Your days are full of ordering, menu planning, and rota work, and you try to get some time with your family on Sunday afternoons.
